repo.description:
### Impact

A missing token type check allowed to retrieve more additional information about the WOPI configuration with a user or guest token.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Richdocuments app is upgraded to 9.1.1, 10.2.1 or 11.0.1

### Workarounds

* Disable app richdocuments

### References


* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3568116)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/richdocuments/pull/5841)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Unnecessary parts of WOPI configration returned in richdocuments
